# ByVasoVasiko

ByVasoVasiko is a tattoo studio for custom Japanese tattoo art, including irezumi. The studio works in Istanbul and Düsseldorf.

## Istanbul
Asmalı Mescit Mahallesi, İstiklal Caddesi No:164, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye
Phone: +90 533 203 67 40

## Düsseldorf
Königsallee 45-47, 40212 Düsseldorf, Germany
Phone: +49 163 787 99 67

Email: termini@vasovasiko.com
Hours: Monday to Saturday 10:00–20:00, Sunday closed
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vasovasiko/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vasovasiko

Book with the appointment form. The studio replies by email or WhatsApp.
